test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, we need a word that quantifies child marriages.
 
• The word 'number' is the most suitable term that generally quantifies a collection or group of items or events.
 
• Since the passage talks about successful efforts in reducing child marriages in the area, 'number' is a direct and clear way to reference the quantity or count of such events.
 
• The use of 'number' conveys specificity and accuracy, fitting well in the context.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: '* 'It was a matter of immense pleasure that the Chief of Police himself came up to us and congratulated us on our successful efforts in reducing the **number **of child marriages in our area. We were also (3) _________ by other (4) _________ present at the event. Our dear leader, the founder of our NGO, Mr. Kumar was (5) _________ by the mayor with a bouquet.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Aggregate': This term is usually used to represent a whole formed by combining several elements. In the provided context, it may not appropriately describe the quantity of child marriages.
 
• 'Limit': Generally, 'limit' refers to a restriction or constraint. It does not appear suitable to refer to the quantity of child marriages in the current context.
 
• 'Quota': The term 'quota' implies a fixed share or proportion of something that a person or group is entitled to achieve or contribute. This does not directly correlate with the reference to child marriages in the current context.
